items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Ivy the girl friend of Charlie Lewis

ctx.x: I drank less alcohol in India than I was drinking in Europe and I suppose the desire was less demanding because of the climate, although hot climates have been known to make alcoholic wrecks of many men. We had plenty of canned beer that was furnished to us by the hotel. For a woman, Aimee Denton could down a few. Leon liked a taste of gage now and then and Charlie "Dizzie" Lewis liked his juice although he did not drink too much while we were in Bombay.

But one day Dizzie got on a bender and bought a python from an Indian who had a street act for tourists which was a battle between a snake and a mongoose. So Dizzy bought a python and took it home. His girl friends Ivy was not at home when he arrived. In fact no one was there and the juice started getting Dizzy down, so he got on a bed with the python and went to sleep.

When Ivy did come home, the sight that she saw sent her out of the house screaming like mad. Charlie was lying on his back with his mouth wide open, the python was coiled around his body and it's head was five inches from Charlie's mouth. The alcohol scent from Charlie's breath must have paralysed the python to the point that it could not squeeze the life out of Dizzy. Ivy went to get her brother to come back home with her and with the help of some other friends, they got the python into a cloth sack and gave it…
